subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` suppress supervised control-plane `update.run` managed-service handoffs for headless Gateways, or remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally split background auto-update suppression from explicit control-plane update requests, and changing that split affects operator/UI update behavior rather than only fixing a local implementation bug.

options.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
options.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as a hard block for Gateway-originated managed update handoffs before restart scheduling, with focused update handler/docs/tests and macOS launchd proof.

options.title: Keep it background-only
options.body: Document that the env var only suppresses configured automatic applies and route explicit `update.run` restart reliability to the existing launchd handoff issues.

options.title: Add a separate headless policy
options.body: Introduce a distinct opt-out for supervised control-plane package update restarts, accepting a new config/env surface to avoid overloading the existing variable.

recommendation.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
recommendation.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as a hard block for Gateway-originated managed update handoffs before restart scheduling, with focused update handler/docs/tests and macOS launchd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product contract decision across the core updater, Gateway restart loop, and macOS service behavior, where steipete has both recent and foundational history.
